# Campaign 1 Locations

Short notes on the places Campaign 1 keeps returning to. All of them are invented for this chronicle.

## The Harrow Gallery, Chelsea

A converted warehouse on West 22nd Street that [[Rene Valentine]] uses for the autumn masquerade ball. Three floors, a roof terrace, and a cold room in the basement that is never on the tour.

## The Fenwick Street pumping station

A decommissioned waterworks on the Lower East Side. [[Calebros]] holds court in the old control room. The stairs down from the pump hall go further than the building plans say.

## The Ashgrove Chantry

A brownstone on the Upper West Side with too many chimneys. [[Hakim Olamaz]] keeps the Tremere of the city here under rules he wrote himself.

## Saint Brendan's, Lower East Side

A parish church whose night watchman is more than he seems. The hunter cell meets in its basement on Thursdays.

## The Pelham Bay platform

An abandoned subway platform under the Bronx where the Nosferatu trade in rumours. Neutral ground by long custom.

## Marleina's offices

The top two floors of a glass tower on Sixth Avenue. Nothing official happens here, which is why everything does.
